# vastdata_rack (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_rack" "vastdb_rack" {
  name        = "rack-2"
  ip_range    = ["1.1.1.1", "1.1.1.10"]
  description = "This is test rack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rack name

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `ip_range` (Set of String)
- `number_of_units` (Number)
- `rack_unit` (String)
- `row` (String)

### Read-Only

- `available_capacity` (Number)
- `cnode_ip_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `cnode_ipmi_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `dnode_ip_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `dnode_ipmi_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `guid` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `is_bgp_enabled` (Boolean) Is BGP enabled for the rack
- `total_capacity` (Number)
